hints.title: Starting the Limelight
hints.content: Call `limelight.pipelineSwitch(0)` to select the pipeline, then `limelight.start()` to begin processing. Do this before calling getLatestResult().

hints.title: Reading the result
hints.content: Call `LLResult result = limelight.getLatestResult()`. Always null-check: `if (result != null && result.isValid())`. Then use `result.getTx()` and `result.getTy()` for the overall target offsets.

hints.title: Iterating fiducial results
hints.content: Call `result.getFiducialResults()` which returns a `List<LLResultTypes.FiducialResult>`. Loop with `for (LLResultTypes.FiducialResult tag : result.getFiducialResults())`, then use `tag.getFiducialId()` and `tag.getTargetXDegrees()`.
